decisions.quote: These results replicate Knudsen and Liszkowski’s (2012) findings with 24-month-old children and partially extend them to 3-yearold children, suggesting that an age group population of children well known to fail explicit false belief tasks is nonetheless motivated by an experimenter’s lack of awareness to engage in more helpful, informing behaviors.
decisions.reason: The shipped outcome ('mixed') conflates the paper's overall results across different paradigms, whereas Experiment 2 specifically re-tested Knudsen and Liszkowski (2012) and explicitly concluded that the original findings with 24-month-olds were replicated.
